rx_iface.description: Network interface to monitor for received bytes

tx_iface.description: Network interface to monitor for transmitted bytes

display_mode.description: Display mode: 'plain' for text-only output, 'smooth' for graphical

display_style.description: Graphical style: 'smoothed' for smoothed display, 'blocky' for old blocky display

monitored_file.description: Path to a file to monitor download speed/progress. Leave empty for network only.

monitored_file_size.description: Expected size of the monitored file in bytes. Used with monitored_file.

report_zero_size.description: Report zero size on files that don't exist instead of waiting
